name: devmind-ai
description: Full Stack AI Software Engineer Workspace

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.lint: concurrently "cd client && npm run lint" "cd server && npm run lint"
